description.narrative: (Uganda): .The Uganda Biodiversity fund supports sustainable financing for biodiversity conservation in Uganda. The activity will invite private sector actors to engage in conservation and strengthen public institutions and local organizations to manage natural resources, including biodiversity, effectively. In 2018, USAID/Uganda initiated a modification of the existing USAID/Uganda Biodiversity Trust Fund (UBTF) award to include provisions that would enable a transition award to the Uganda Biodiversity Fund (UBF), the conservation trust fund created under the UBTF Activity. Following completion of the UBTF Activity, USAID/Uganda will initiate the UBF transition award using FY 2018 funds. The goal of this award is to support Ugandan-led development by enhancing the UBF's role as a catalyst for private conservation financing and an apex partner for local conservation organizations through the mobilization of small grants. These grants will be aimed at stimulating grassroots conservation efforts in Uganda's key biodiversity areas and will demonstrate UBF's effectiveness to potential private sector donors, which will support UBF's transition to a self-sustaining entity. The prime awardee of the existing UBTF activity, the Wildlife Conservation Society, will remain engaged on the transition award as a sub-awardee to provide technical guidance..... .
